diagnostics.message: The Splunk AWS integration can be created before its inline permissions policy is attached. Its metric-stream integration requires these AWS permissions, and the provider documentation recommends ordering the integration after role-related policy resources; no attribute reference can express this ordering cleanly.

The Splunk AWS integration can be created before its metric-stream managed policy is attached.
